headline: Continuous coordinate-bearing public photographs recover visible capitulum variation compressed by taxon means; environmental alignment is endpoint- and scale-specific, with two among-taxon adaptive-pattern candidates under current sequential controls.
methodological_headline: A frozen 27-endpoint contract preserves repeated numerical phenotypes, coordinates, trait-specific missingness and within- versus among-taxon estimands instead of reducing each taxon to a category or mean.

trait_contract.interpretation: visible image-phenotype variation, not genetic variance, heritability or plasticity

sampling_composition.claim_ceiling: directional stability only; not a probability-sample correction, new discovery family or causal test

adaptive_pattern_candidates_under_curren.candidate_mechanism: radiation-responsive floral pigment regulation, including an anthocyanin-synthesis hypothesis
adaptive_pattern_candidates_under_curren.mechanism_boundary: CIELAB chroma is not anthocyanin concentration or UV reflectance; the negative coefficient does not identify pigment amount or pathway mediation
adaptive_pattern_candidates_under_curren.decisive_next_test: calibrated visible and UV reflectance plus petal anthocyanin chemistry or pathway expression under common-garden radiation manipulation

adaptive_pattern_candidates_under_curren.candidate_mechanism: more downward-facing capitulum presentation may shield reproductive tissues from rain
adaptive_pattern_candidates_under_curren.mechanism_boundary: the 0-up, 90-horizontal, 180-down scale is relative to EXIF image vertical, not gravity; rain interception, pollen viability and fitness were not measured
adaptive_pattern_candidates_under_curren.decisive_next_test: gravity-referenced 3D orientation with flowering-period rain, pollen retention and viability, seed output and experimental angle manipulation

secondary_whole_capitulum.role: secondary synthesis; does not select endpoint rows or replace decomposed geography

submission_blockers: independent orientation, colour and outline reference measurements
independent botanical calibration of candidate involucral and surface-image metrics
paired flower/background colour calibration and negative control
repeat-photo trait remeasurement and variance decomposition
licence selection and durable DOI release
withdrawn_from_active_submission_tree: legacy lability-responsiveness and median-split quadrant result
PR69-era nine-endpoint result hierarchy as a trait-selection rule
categorical CLIP or AI trait-environment atlas
